  • Interfaces
    Class
    Description
    AccountAgreement
    An agreement associated with an Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 account at an IBX, as returned by GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts/{accountNumber}/agreements.
    AccountDetails
    An Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 billing account, as returned by the account lookups GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts and GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts/{accountNumber}.
    Cabinet
    A cabinet in an Equinix IBX data center, as returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 product-availability lookup GET /internetAccess/v1/cabinets.
    Cage
    A cage in an Equinix IBX data center, as returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 product-availability lookup GET /internetAccess/v1/cages.
    ConnectionService
    A connection service available at an Equinix IBX data center, as returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 product-availability lookup GET /internetAccess/v1/connectionServices.
    CustomerRoute
    A customer-route allowance on an Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 default configuration: an import policy plus the advertised prefix length.
    CustomerRouteConfiguration
    An allowed customer-route configuration for an Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 service, as returned by GET /internetAccess/v1/customerRouteConfigurations.
    DedicatedBandwidthConfiguration
    An allowed dedicated-bandwidth configuration for an Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 service, as returned by GET /internetAccess/v1/dedicatedBandwidthConfigurations.
    DedicatedPortDefaultConfiguration
    A default dedicated-port configuration for an Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 service, as returned by GET /internetAccess/v1/dedicatedPortDefaultConfigurations.
    Ibx
    An Equinix IBX data center where Equinix Internet Access (EIA) is available, as returned by the product-availability lookup GET /internetAccess/v2/ibxs.
    InternetAccessService
    An Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v2 service, as returned by the create (POST /internetAccess/v2/services), get-details (GET /internetAccess/v2/services/{serviceId}), update (PATCH /internetAccess/v2/services/{serviceId}) and search (POST /internetAccess/v2/services/search) operations.
    OperationalUnit
    An Equinix Internet Access (EIA) operational unit, as returned by the v1 operational-units lookup (GET /internetAccess/v1/operationalUnits).
    OrderDetails
    The full details of an Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 order, as returned by the single get (GET /internetAccess/v1/orders/{orderUUID}).
    PatchPanel
    A patch panel in an Equinix IBX data center, as returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 product-availability lookup GET /internetAccess/v1/patchPanels.
    PortConfiguration
    An allowed port configuration for an Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 service, as returned by GET /internetAccess/v1/portConfigurations.
    Price
    An Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 price entry, as returned by the price search POST /internetAccess/v1/prices/search.
    PurchaseOrder
    A purchase order available to a billing account, as returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 purchase-order lookups — the list (GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts/{accountNumber}/purchaseOrders) and the single get (GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts/{accountNumber}/purchaseOrders/{number}).
    RoutingProtocolConfiguration
    An allowed routing-protocol configuration for an Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 service, as returned by GET /internetAccess/v1/routingProtocolConfigurations.
    SignaturePolicy
    An Equinix Internet Access (EIA) signature policy, as returned by the v1 signature-policies lookup (GET /internetAccess/v1/signaturePolicies).
    TermsAndConditions
    A set of Equinix Internet Access (EIA) terms and conditions, as returned by the v1 terms lookup (GET /internetAccess/v1/terms).
    VirtualBandwidthConfiguration
    An allowed virtual-bandwidth configuration for an Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 service, as returned by GET /internetAccess/v1/virtualBandwidthConfigurations.
    VirtualConnectionDefaultConfiguration
    A default virtual-connection configuration for an Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 service, as returned by GET /internetAccess/v1/virtualConnectionDefaultConfigurations.
